method: Native macOS ARM64 engine converted with pinned macos-on-ios compatibility layer
preserve: All upstream features including official Frame Interpolation, menus, shader compilation, prewarm, loading and game timing
Korean patch variants, font clipping/spacing/punctuation, sprite and paragraph placement, approved Settings art, movie subtitles
iPhone native aspect/resolution, safe areas, touch input and controllers
iOS haptic preparation/recovery and foreground recovery
ISO import, portable save/config locations, Korean link repair after container relocation
Ninja Gaiden Black display name and approved icon
Original upstream debugging and F7 behavior
exclude: Prior iOS VF3 Smooth Motion adapter and its performance/water experiments
Prior custom universal shader fallback and patched MoltenVK
Port-added diagnostic writers, samplers, dump files and overlays
Prior loading/cache acceleration, shader preparation gates and user-captured recipes
settings_migration: Upstream text_language uses Auto/English/Japanese; separate ios_text_language and original Options selector support Korean. Audio Output 25 and Frame Interpolation 45 retain upstream numbers; Korean uses internal 46.
source_safety: No private game files, generated C, device logs, captured shaders or credentials in source. Encrypted IPA only.
